nuggets.text: Saturday marks the Ducks' first-ever trip to Stillwater to face Oklahoma State.
The Ducks have won 12 straight road games, the longest active road winning streak in the country.
Dan Lanning played linebacker at William Jewell College in Missouri before coaching high school ball in Kansas City.
The Oregon Duck exists thanks to a 1947 handshake deal between athletic director Leo Harris and Walt Disney.
The tradition of declaring "It never rains in Autzen Stadium" before Ducks home games dates to 1990.
Autzen Stadium is named for Portland lumberman Thomas J. Autzen, who was an Oregon State alumnus.
Kenny Wheaton's 1994 interception against Washington is replayed on the Autzen big screen before every home game.
Oregon earned its first Rose Bowl invite partly because train tickets from Eugene were cheaper, then beat Penn 14-0.
Dante Moore threw for 378 yards and three touchdowns in the Ducks' 34-27 opening win over Boise State.
Dakorien Moore's 62-yard touchdown catch put the Ducks ahead for good against Boise State.
